# Class: `CellEditController`

Coordinates selection, single/group edits, preview placement, and committed cell geometry.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-cell-controller.md) · [Source](../src/icescopy_cell_controller.py#L42) · [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `object`.

Preview state includes whether the layout is floating or pinned. Applying a preview uses the window’s history support; avoid treating the preview graphics as saved cells.
